## Module Objectives

At the end of this module, you should be able to:

- Clean and analyze textual data.
- Build a simple sentiment lexicon in French.
- Visualize lexical and emotional trends over time.
- Use TF-IDF to identify distinctive words.
- Create an interactive dashboard with `flexdashboard` and `shiny`.

<h3 class="unnumbered" id="challenge-deployed-dashboard">Challenge — Deployed Dashboard</h3>
<p>You need to build an interactive dashboard from the template provided. This dashboard must:</p>
<ul>
<li>Display a sentiment score per week;</li>
<li>Identify distinctive words (TF-IDF) or a word cloud;</li>
<li>Analyze numerical variables (<code>plaisir</code>, <code>engagement</code>, <code>difficulte</code>);</li>
<li>Be personalized (filtering, colors, summary);</li>
<li>Be deployed and shared with Anne-Sophie.</li>
</ul>
<p>The complete instructions are available on the <a href="defi.html">Challenge 10</a> page. The starter repository is <code>STT-1100/aventure-10</code>.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </details>
